title: Night Cream for All Skin Types: How One Cream Can Suit Oily, Dry and Combination Skin
ex: Can one night cream suit every skin type? Yes, if the texture is balanced and you change the amount. Here is what to look for and how much to use.
rt: Night Cream for All Skin Types: How to Pick and Use | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for all skin types: textures and ingredients for oily, dry, combination and sensitive skin, how much to use, and one cream to share.
keyword: night cream for all skin types
quick: A night cream for all skin types has a medium, non-greasy texture with water-holding ingredients like aloe vera and a gentle all-rounder like niacinamide. Use half a pea for oily skin, a pea for normal and combination skin, and a little more for dry skin.
facts: Aloe vera and niacinamide suit most skin
Oily: half a pea; dry: a little more
Patch test if your skin is sensitive
